sections.name: Dinner Menu
sections.note: Family-style dinner with an all ye care to feast menu. Each family will receive a three-course meal. Soft drinks included. 18% automatic gratuity will be added to parties of 6 guests or more

items.name: Three-course family-style dinner
items.description: Salad: mixed green salad with toasted almonds, dried cranberries, fresh tomatoes, fresh apples, red onion and asiago cheese tossed with homemade poppy seed dressing; vegan option available upon request (65 kcal). Main course, one platter for the family to share: Pirate Platter (slow-smoked beef brisket, BBQ pulled pork, spare ribs, rotisserie chicken, smoked sausage; 1450 kcal), Seadog Skillet (grilled marinated flank steak, herb roasted pork tenderloin, blackened fish, sauteed garlic citrus shrimp, rotisserie chicken; 1100 kcal) or Plant Based Skillet (plant based meatloaf, crispy teriyaki tofu & broccoli, grilled cauliflower steaks, vegetable dumplings; 700 kcal). Dessert: Pirate Captain's Delight, warm chocolate chip cookie skillet with vanilla bean ice cream (275 kcal), or Plant Based Dessert, warm dairy free chocolate fondue (150 kcal). Calories are per person
